one_liner: Zoho Cliq has a broad REST API (v2/v3) with self-serve OAuth 2.0 via the Zoho API Console and a free plan; the vendor MCP server claim could not be verified from the provided pages.
auth_notes: REST API uses OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with a client registered in the Zoho API Console. Datacenter-specific accounts.zoho.{dc} domains. Integration-component (bot/webhook) API tokens are also issued and passed as request parameters.
access_notes: A Free plan exists and OAuth client registration in the API console is self-serve. The fetched plan-comparison page is truncated before the 'API support' row, so free-plan API availability is inferred, not directly confirmed.
blocker_notes: Minor: per-datacenter handling required. The free-plan API claim and the MCP claim are not directly confirmed in the provided page text.

evidence.quote: Zoho Cliq API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication.
registering your app with the [**Zoho API console**](https://api-console.zoho.com/). Once you register your client, you will get a Client ID and Client secret for your application.
API tokens are also provided while creating an application with the integration components.
The Zoho Cliq API is based on REST principles. It enables you to perform read-and-write operations similar to those available with our web client.
v3 introduces CRUD API endpoints for bots, slash commands, message actions, widgets, schedulers, and more, which were not available in v2.
